interview.hardest_part: Navigating the hotel's corridors, doorways, fire, and elevator sequence while aiming precisely with discrete half-second key holds and only screenshots for feedback. The full score also requires extensive combat and survival grinding beyond simply finishing the chapter.
interview.likely_failure: Losing orientation or becoming stuck on geometry in the early hotel route, then wasting time on repeated movement corrections; if I reach the elevator, the crowded horde fight is the most likely place for incapacitation or uncontrolled friendly fire.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Easy difficulty, three AI teammates who can fight and revive me, automatic weapons, shoving for close-range space, and abundant common infected for kill and shot milestones. Route and survival milestones can also be earned incrementally without needing a full chapter completion.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Coarse turning and movement make fine aiming, doorway alignment, and hazard avoidance difficult. Hordes and special infected can attack outside the current view, fire and darkness obscure navigation, and waiting for revives or fighting around teammates can consume limited wall-clock time. The 300-kill, 16-special-infected, repeated-heal/revive, and 20-minute survival requirements make 100 points especially unlikely.
